brief: Two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell COLT '98, doi:10.1145/279943.279962): View A potential-field/subsurface (gravity 5/11/13/18, magnetic 1/2/3/9/14, strain 4/7/8, seismicity 10/16, depth 15, conductivity 17), View B surface (DEM 12/19 + radiometric TC band 6 + GeoDAWN K/Th/U extensions + 1-m LiDAR scarp stack); independence tested empirically on spatial-block out-of-fold negative errors with abandonment at max|r| >= 0.60; pseudo-labels only where one view is confident and the other abstains, whole-segment blocks with buffer; disagreement as discovery signal; single-view baselines on hide-and-recover; per-A-only-candidate written geological reasoning; [0,1] GeoTIFF on the pinned grid with the repo metric-aware placement, uniqueness gate, and not-merely-union confirmation.

data_integrity.required_action: Verify every input file's SHA-256 and byte count against the manifest before any read; fail closed on mismatch; record the measured hashes of all three tracked data/*.tif stubs and their inequality to the pins in evidence/h59_preflight_integrity.json (never overwrite data/*.tif).
data_integrity.qualification: The pins are owner-supplied GitHub mirrors verified by hash and byte count; that proves mirror integrity, NOT organizer authentication. Every H59 receipt repeats this qualification.
data_integrity.tracked_data_policy: The tracked data/training_features.tif is a grid stub (19 zero bands; sha 9c450a754ed95869); data/labels.tif and data/sample_submission.tif likewise differ from the pins. No H59 number may be computed from tracked data/*.tif.

protocol.folds: HO.make_folds n_folds=4 buffer_px=4 prevalence=0.002; fit-on-block per run_h57_cotrain.py; arms scored on tip and hide instruments with identical fold geometry
protocol.emitter: isotropic 3 px (h57.iso_select); anisotropic emitter is NOT used (refuted, evidence/h57_validation.json placement)
protocol.pool: fold region & footprint & ~dilate(catalogue, 2 px) [the <=200 m ring rule], candidates may not sit on the visible catalogue dilated by 2 px; held-out catalogue is scored as truth

challengers.H59-A: x_corroborated = u * (0.55 + 0.45*lid) where lid = normalized sqrt(rank(B_lidar_coh100_val) * rank(B_lidar_ex_max_val)) over the permitted pool
challengers.H59-C: x_strain = coh(grad(2ndinv)+grad(shear)) >= 0.25 * ridge_strength(sum of both grads) * (1 - rank(dist_band_10)); label-free
challengers.H59-D: halo population: 3-6 px annulus of the exactly-accounted P1 core, pool-restricted, corroboration-weighted; scored as pool density statistic
challengers.H59-E: x_geoconj = u * (0.6 + 0.4*rank(band17 | band15 > median depth of pool))

decision_rules.independence: spatial.independence on block error rows; measured and non-degenerate required to allow the exchange; abandonment at max|r| >= 0.60 forces the single-view fallback and is reported as a refutation
decision_rules.field_promotion: a challenger replaces the union field for arm selection iff its fold-mean DTI exceeds the union fold-mean in all four cells {tip,hide} x {15000,37654}; otherwise union ships and the result is reported as the incumbent
decision_rules.slot_approval_bar: mean lift vs matched random >= +0.005 on both instruments at budget 37654 AND >= 3/4 folds positive on each; unmet => artifact downloadable for review but NOT approved to spend a weekly slot
decision_rules.halo_gate_H59D: k-weighted held-truth density of the halo pool >= 2.0x the random control of equal size in the same legal pool on the tip instrument; unmet => halo not emitted
decision_rules.not_merely_union: report fraction of emitted arm pixels outside the top-k set of the plain union field; also artifact != any prior, != union of prior pairs, and (when a challenger ships) != union top-k
decision_rules.novelty: arm 100% outside the support union of all accessible aligned priors; decoded pattern unique vs every accessible aligned prior incl. this repo's own archived artifacts and the restored scored/calib priors

prohibitions: No leaderboard score may enter model fitting, field construction, fold geometry, or arm selection; revealed-preference arithmetic (gems52.revealed) may size budgets and project outcomes only, labelled conditional on owner-reported scores.
No number here is a leaderboard forecast; Spearman(reported, simulated DTI) = -0.1045 (knowledge/10 s5).
A-only reasoning rows are hypotheses for Phase-2 review, never 'discovered faults'.
